models.name: ace2-era5
models.notes: ACE2-ERA5 (Ai2), deterministic, trained on ERA5 1979-2008/2012-2019; shipped ICs: 12 monthly times in 1979 and 2001.

models.name: ace2-shield
models.notes: ACE2-SHiELD (Ai2), deterministic, trained on SHiELD; single shipped IC (1979-01-01) shared from ACE2S-SHiELD-plus AMIP package; amip-oos = AIMIP SST/SIC 2015-2024 (Zenodo 17065758).

models.name: ace2s-shield-plus
models.notes: ACE2S-SHiELD-plus (Ai2), stochastic (ensemble members via IC replication along sample + model noise); shipped IC: 1979-01-01 from AMIP package.

models.name: ace2-eamv3
models.notes: ACE2-EAMv3 (Ai2), deterministic, trained on E3SMv3 EAM; noleap calendar; window 1994-2014 only. Shipped ic_1994.nc is an E3SM 1971-01-01 state relabelled to 1994-01-01; discard the first simulated year as spin-up.

models.name: hiro-ace
models.notes: HiRO-ACE ACE2S stage (Ai2), stochastic; trained only on 9 years of X-SHiELD (2014-2022) and not expected by the authors to generalize outside training forcing. Here 2014-2022 (in amip-oos 2014-2024) is the training period, and amip-hist (1994-2014) is AIMIP's experimental extension outside training. Shipped ic_1994.nc is a HiRO 2014-01-01 state (ic_2014.nc[0]) relabelled to 1994-01-01; discard the first simulated year as spin-up.

models.name: ace2-som
models.notes: ACE2-SOM (Ai2 / GFDL SHiELD slab-ocean), deterministic, proleptic_gregorian; scenario forcing sets 1xCO2 (default) and 3xCO2 over 2032-2035, each paired with its equilibrated mixed-layer IC.

models.name: ace2s
models.notes: ACE2S standalone global stochastic atmosphere emulator (allenai/HiRO-ACE ACE2S.ckpt, trained on X-SHiELD 2014-2022; HF-native 2014-2023 training-period forcing and ic_2014/ic_2023; julian calendar).

models.name: hiro-acev2
models.notes: HiRO-ACEv2 global ACE2S-X-SHiELD stage (allenai/HiRO-ACEv2, trained on X-SHiELD 2014-2022, fme 2026.10.0 overlay), stochastic, julian calendar; HF-native 2014-2023 training-period forcing and ic_2014/ic_2023 (3 km downscaler deferred).

models.name: samudrace-cm4
models.notes: SamudrACE-CM4 coupled atmosphere-ocean piControl emulator (Ai2/M2LInES/GFDL, fme 2026.5.1, fme.coupled.inference); 120h (5-day) coupled step = 20x6h atmosphere steps, noleap calendar; 1-year forcing_0311.nc / forcing_0151.nc extended via n_repeats when multi-year.

models.name: samudrace-e3smv3
models.notes: SamudrACE-E3SMv3 stochastic coupled atmosphere-ocean piControl emulator (Ai2, fme 2026.10.0 overlay, fme.coupled.inference); 120h (5-day) coupled step = 20x6h atmosphere steps, noleap calendar; 1-year native forcing (max 72 coupled steps; fme 2026.10.0 has no n_repeats) + 3-state ICx3 at 0425-01-03T12:00:00.

models.name: dlesym-v1.0
models.notes: DLESyM v1.0 (NVIDIA/UW, Earth2Studio): the prior ERA5 checkpoint of the S2S model, deprecated upstream; aimip loads checkpoint pair 0 of 4. Coupled atmosphere-ocean on HEALPix-64, output on 0.25 deg lat-lon, deterministic. The authors built the V1 checkpoints for subseasonal-to-seasonal forecasts (weeks to months); multi-year runs are outside what they validated. Multi-year rollouts can become unstable; aimip stops a run at the first non-finite or out-of-band month. Starts from ERA5 at --start (ARCO-ERA5, fetched at prepare time), not forced; --steps counts 6-h steps.

models.name: dlesym-v1.1
models.notes: DLESyM v1.1 (Earth2Studio), AI Weather Quest checkpoint with conditional layer norm: samples noise every step, so --members gives distinct members (seed + k). The authors built the V1 checkpoints for subseasonal-to-seasonal forecasts (weeks to months); multi-year runs are outside what they validated. aimip stops a run at the first non-finite or out-of-band month. Diagnostic 6-h precipitation tp6 (monthly_precip.nc). Starts from ERA5 at --start; --steps counts 6-h steps.

models.name: dlesym-v0-isccp
models.notes: DLESyMv0-ISCCP (Earth2Studio): the climate checkpoint Earth2Studio documents for 100-1000-year rollouts (Cresswell-Clay et al. 2024). It takes ISCCP-like OLR; with use_ttr the ERA5 OLR of the initial state is converted by the authors' day-of-year moment matching, then the model uses its own OLR. Deterministic; starts from ERA5 at --start; --steps counts 6-h steps.

models.name: archesclimate-ssp
models.notes: ArchesClimate-SSP deterministic (INRIA/Mila, Clyne et al. 2026): monthly emulator of IPSL-CM6A-LR on a 144 x 144 grid (1.25 deg lat x 2.5 deg lon), atmosphere + upper-ocean temperature, driven by the scenario's forcing. Starts from the scenario's 2015 state (--start 2015-01-01T00:00:00; first output March 2015); --steps counts months (at most 1029); --forcing-set ssp434 (default, the authors' validation scenario) or ssp585 (test).

models.name: archesweather
models.notes: ArchesWeather-Mx4, AIMIP version (INRIA): the four ArchesWeather-M networks (seeds 0-3) averaged at every daily step, as in the authors' AIMIP runs; deterministic. 1-degree grid, 6 surface variables and 6 variables on 13 pressure levels as daily means, forced by monthly ERA5 SST and sea-ice cover (Zenodo 22795233). Starts from the ERA5 daily-mean state of 1978-09-30 only (--start 1978-09-30T00:00:00; first output day 1978-10-01, like the authors' AIMIP member r2); --steps counts days (at most 16894, to 2024-12-31). aimip's rollout follows the paper (Singh et al. 2026, arXiv:2605.29976, section 2.3); the authors' rollout script is not published.

models.name: archesweathergen
models.notes: ArchesWeatherGen, AIMIP version (INRIA): a flow-matching model that samples the next state around the ArchesWeather-Mx4 prediction (25 sampler steps per day); stochastic, --members gives distinct noise seeds (seed + k). 1-degree grid, 6 surface variables and 6 variables on 13 pressure levels as daily means, forced by monthly ERA5 SST and sea-ice cover (Zenodo 22795233). Starts from the ERA5 daily-mean state of 1978-09-30 only (--start 1978-09-30T00:00:00; first output day 1978-10-01, like the authors' AIMIP member r2); --steps counts days (at most 16894, to 2024-12-31). aimip's rollout follows the paper (Singh et al. 2026, arXiv:2605.29976, section 2.3); the authors' rollout script is not published.

models.name: samudra-om4
models.notes: Samudra thermo-dynamic global ocean emulator of GFDL OM4 (M2LInES, Dheeshjith et al. 2025, seed1 checkpoint): 1 deg grid (180 x 360, 19 fixed depths 2.5-6000 m), 5-day mean step (120 h, even --steps >= 2), julian calendar. Replays a window of the OM4 JRA55-do OMIP-2 store (staged from OSN s3://m2lines-pubs/Samudra at prepare time); independent test period starts 2014-09-30T12:00:00 (earlier dates are inside training/validation).

models.name: md-1.5
models.notes: Monthly Diffusion v0.9 at 1.5 deg (UMD, Hall & Molina 2026, arXiv:2604.13481; kjhall01/monthly-diffusion@b077d3bc MIT, MD-1p5-latest.pth): stochastic latent-diffusion atmosphere emulator on 121 x 240 regular lat-lon (37 prognostic channels, 250 reverse DDPM steps/month, single monthly state per step with counts=1). Forced by AIMIP Phase 1 monthly SST/SIC (Zenodo 17065758, CC-BY-4.0, 556 month-start-centred points 1978-10-01 .. 2025-01-01; training 1985-2014, independent test 2015-2022; requires >= 10-year spin-up). Upstream publishes no initial state: pass --ic <era5_monthly_state.nc> or stage inputs/md-1.5/ic/ic_<YYYY-MM-DD>.nc.

models.name: camulator
models.notes: CAMulator deterministic 6-hourly 1 deg 32-level atmosphere emulator (NCAR MILES/CREDIT, Chapman et al. 2025, checkpoint.pt00069.pt). Emulates CAM6 / ERA5-scaled climate target (1980-2014; 4 dynamic forcings SOLIN, SST, ICEFRAC, co2vmr_3d — differs from the 2-forcing 1979-2010 model in arXiv:2504.06007). Starts from any of 69 published noleap initial states (1980-01-01, Jan 1 & Jul 1 of 1981-2014); --forcing-set camulator-cyclic-1yr (default) or camulator-branch-1980-2014 (1980-2014 b.e21 forcing, SST source undocumented upstream). Runs in isolated venv-camulator (torch 2.4.1, torch_harmonics 0.7.2, numpy<2).

models.name: cbottle-3d
models.notes: cBottle-3d conditional atmospheric state generator (NVIDIA, Brenowitz et al. 2025, NVlabs/cBottle@f0f51998 via Earth2Studio CBottle3D; nvidia/cbottle@e60ce82b Apache-2.0): not a time-stepping simulation — adjacent days are independent diffusion draws conditioned only on (day_of_year, hour_of_day) and monthly mid-point SST (PCMDI-AMIP-1-1-9 tosbcs, 1940-01-01 .. 2022-12-16; dates >= 2018 are outside the 1980-2017 ERA5 training range; no initial state, CO2, or sea-ice input). Default daily_synoptic cadence (00/06/12/18 UTC, batch_size=4) writes monthly means on 0.25 deg lat-lon.

models.name: spherical-dyffusion
models.notes: Spherical DYffusion probabilistic 6-hourly 1 deg (180 x 360) atmosphere emulator of FV3GFS (Rose-STL-Lab, Ruhling Cachay et al. NeurIPS 2024; salv47/spherical-dyffusion@56fcb5d9 Apache-2.0, Zenodo 10791087 CC-BY-4.0). Emulates a repeating 365-day annual SST cycle (labelled 2021 in the reference files; output months use nominal cycle indices 0001-01.. with exact daily coarsening coarsen_factor=4 over complete calendar months). Predicts 34 fields; surface_temperature is prescribed over ocean and stored as surface_temperature_prescribed_ocean, while predicted lowest-layer air_temperature_7 (K) is summarized. Runs in isolated venv-sdyff (apex FusedLayerNorm replaced by torch.nn.LayerNorm, numerically equivalent up to float rounding; published checkpoints use normalization_layer='instance_norm' / torch.nn.InstanceNorm2d).
